on Wednesday announced the renewal of its Normal Course Issuer Bid (NCIB) for an additional one-year period.
This enables the company to purchase and cancel up to 7.25M common shares, representing 5% of its public float as of September 4, 2026, over the 12-month period commencing September 18, 2026.
As of September 4, 2026, Gibson had 172.56M common shares issued and outstanding.

title: Gibson Energy renews normal course issuer bid to repurchase up to 7.25M shares
